as_told.title: James Bruce seeks the Ark and brings back the Book of Enoch

plain: The Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text that is not part of most Bibles, is said to have reached the West because a Scot named James Bruce brought it back from Ethiopia. The writer Graham Hancock tells this on the show without naming a source. He credits Bruce's own book, Travels to Discover the Source of the Nile, and the English translation of Enoch by R. H. Charles, published in 1917. Michels tells it himself on another episode and adds two things. He calls Bruce a Scottish Freemason, and he says Bruce went to Ethiopia looking for the Ark of the Covenant and "came back with the book of Enoch." The tellers care about it because it brought a text back into circulation that some read as an account of beings from the sky who came down among humans.
